subject: Ephemeral seat liability & collection guidance for Catalyst Biotech
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: Catalyst ephemeral seats mid-cycle / billing treatment

Marissa / Karthik —

Catalyst Biotech flipped on ephemeral seats for two additional engineers mid-cycle (went live 2027-03-28). They were expecting a pro-rated charge for the partial period but AP has put a hold on payment pending a clear breakdown and VAT handling. They are EU-registered (Germany) but haven't yet provided a VAT ID in writing to us.

Can you: 1) confirm whether we should invoice ephemeral seats as pro-rata (per-day consumption) or bill a minimum one-day charge per seat; 2) prepare a short proforma invoice + XLS calc that shows the per-seat/day math and VAT scenarios (reverse-charge vs standard VAT) so we can forward to their AP; 3) advise whether we need a PO before invoicing (they may require PO #).

I want a crisp email we can send to Lena (Catalyst contact) with the attachment and a clear ask for PO + VAT ID. Assume their canonical entity is Catalyst Biotech GmbH (DE).

Thanks — tight timeline, AP wants resolution this week.

— Sean
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: Catalyst ephemeral seats mid-cycle / billing treatment

Sean —

Working on the calc now. Initial take: we do pro-rate ephemeral seats based on days active during the billing period (our current policy for ephemeral capacity). We'll show both a per-day rate and a per-minute equivalent for transparency so AP can reconcile to their consumption reports.

Notes for the proforma:
- Show gross amount and then display two VAT lines: 1) Reverse-charge (0% VAT) with customer VAT ID field blank placeholder; 2) Standard German VAT (19%) if they don't provide ID.
- Include a short payment terms line: Net 30 from invoice date; indicate bank details and Redwood VAT registration info.

I'll attach two files when ready: proforma PDF + XLS with row-level proration. Karthik — can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with a Net 30 for a mid-cycle proforma (or should we request Net 14 given it's outside our usual monthly invoice run)?

—Marissa
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@catalystbiotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Ephemeral seat charge and proforma (Catalyst Biotech)

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our note: you added two ephemeral seats (software engineering) on 2027-03-28 and we expect to bill those for the remainder of your billing period on a pro-rated basis. Attached is a one-page proforma and an XLS that shows the per-seat/day proration. Attachment stubs: proforma-ephemeral-seats-catalyst-20270404.pdf (PDF), proration-breakdown-ephemeral-20270404.xlsx (XLSX).

Action items for Catalyst AP so we can clear the payment hold:
- Confirm the PO number you want on the invoice (if AP requires a PO we will reissue final invoice referencing that PO).
- Confirm your legal billing entity and VAT ID for reverse-charge (if applicable).
- Confirm whether you want this charged to your monthly consolidated invoice (recommended) or as a standalone mid-cycle invoice.

For clarity: our recommended approach is a pro-rated line item based on days active in the billing month (we show both a daily rate and the total for the remaining days). If you prefer an alternate calculation we can review but need an answer from AP by EOD 2027-04-06 to avoid delaying their March invoice reconciliation.

Thanks — please loop in AP and procurement as needed.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: AP Team <ap@catalystbiotech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@catalystbiotech.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@catalystbiotech.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Ephemeral seat charge and proforma (Catalyst Biotech)

Sean / Marissa —

Thanks for the proforma. A few clarifying items from AP/Procurement side:
1) We require a PO for any mid-cycle charges. PO will be generated but we need the final invoice lines to match the PO exactly (line descriptions, dates).
2) Please provide your VAT registration number. If Redwood is VAT-registered in the EU and we can apply reverse-charge, we will provide our VAT ID and expect net invoice (0% VAT). If not, our accounting will require the 19% German VAT to be applied.
3) Why is the ephemeral seat being pro-rated rather than billed as a usage line item on the next monthly invoice? We typically prefer consolidation.

If you can provide the final invoice with PO placeholder, we will fast-track the PO creation and confirm a payment date (we usually pay on the 15th after invoice receipt).

Regards,
AP Team
Catalyst Biotech GmbH

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: AP Team <ap@catalystbiotech.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@catalystbiotech.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ephemeral seat charge and proforma (Catalyst Biotech)

Hi —

Thanks for the questions — below are the specifics so AP can map to the PO and payment process. I've included the calculation summary inline and attached the XLS for line-level proof.

Proration logic (applies to ephemeral seats enabled mid-cycle):
- Monthly seat rate (per full seat per month): EUR 8,500.00
- Billing period: 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-31 (31 days)
- Seats added: 2 ephemeral seats activated 2027-03-28 (active 4 days: 28,29,30,31)
- Per-seat/day = 8,500 / 31 = EUR 274.19 (rounded to two decimals)
- Charge per ephemeral seat = 274.19 * 4 = EUR 1,096.76
- Total for 2 seats = EUR 2,193.52

VAT handling (two scenarios):
- If Catalyst provides a valid EU VAT ID for Catalyst Biotech GmbH: apply reverse-charge (invoice shows 0% VAT and references customer VAT ID; customer self-accounts for VAT).
- If no VAT ID provided: Redwood will apply 19% German VAT to the gross amount (EUR 2,193.52 * 0.19 = EUR 416.77), making total due EUR 2,610.29.

Payment terms / invoice flow:
- We can issue this as a mid-cycle proforma + final invoice once PO number is provided. We recommend consolidating to the next monthly invoice (line included) if AP prefers one payment run — let us know and we'll mark the invoice accordingly.
- Redwood Finance is comfortable with Net 30 for mid-cycle invoices in standard accounts, but for new processes we ask for Net 14 if the invoice is required to settle an in-period reconciliation. For Catalyst (established customer) Net 30 is acceptable if PO is on file.

Attachments: proforma-ephemeral-seats-catalyst-20270404.pdf (proforma with PO placeholder), proration-breakdown-ephemeral-20270404.xlsx (row-level math).

If you confirm VAT ID and whether you want this as a standalone invoice vs consolidated monthly line, we'll reissue final invoice with PO number embedded.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Finance Operations (billing)
Redwood Inference

From: AP Team <ap@catalystbiotech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@catalystbiotech.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@catalystbiotech.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Ephemeral seat charge and proforma (Catalyst Biotech)

Karthik / Sean —

Thanks for the clear breakdown — that works for AP. PO 2027-CTB-451 will match the lines in your proforma. We will provide a VAT ID in a separate secure message (sending to the finance mailbox) and request you reissue the final invoice with the VAT ID and the PO number included.

We prefer to keep the line on the consolidated monthly invoice for March (please mark as "Included in March consolidated invoice" if you can), but we confirm that payment will be initiated on 2027-04-15 once the final invoice is received with PO and VAT ID.

Regards,
AP Team
Catalyst Biotech GmbH
